watch.summary: The creator reacts to footage of cheerleading robots, narrating a rogue robot climbing steps to watch them right before it tumbles off the platform.

beats.what: Creator shows footage of cheerleading robots doing a pom-pom routine.
A humanoid robot begins climbing up yellow steps towards the stage.
Creator narrating the robot's funny thoughts as it climbs up to get a better view.
The robot misses its footing and tumbles off the platform off-screen.
Creator doubles over in laughter at the robot's sudden drop.
Creator jokes about the robot doing anything to check out ladies.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: Be a freaking man, be a freaking animal, be a freaking robot... we like ladies, man.
watch.why: The visual slapstick of the robot awkwardly taking a spill is hilarious on its own, and the creator's voiceover giving it a hilarious motivation elevates the joke.
